BearerAuth.description: Access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` or `/auth/refresh`. Expires after 15 minutes.

info.description:
REST API for organizations, role-based boards and tasks, comments, and audit logs.

**Authentication:** call `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, copy the `access_token`, and paste it into the Authorize dialog. Access tokens expire after 15 minutes; use `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` to rotate them.

**Tenancy:** the active organization is embedded in the access token. Use `POST /api/v1/auth/switch-org` to change it.

**Errors:** every error, including validation failures (`422`), uses the envelope `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`.
info.title: TaskFlow API

post.description:
Verifies the credentials and returns an access token for the user's first organization. Use `POST /api/v1/auth/switch-org` to change organization.

**Roles:** public.

An unknown email, a wrong password and a disabled account all return the same `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS` response.

The refresh token is set in an `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict` cookie scoped to `/api/v1/auth`; it is never returned in the body. Swagger UI sends it automatically when served from the same origin as the API.

401.description: Invalid email or password

403.description: Account belongs to no organization

post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description:
Revokes the refresh token family of the cookie and clears the cookie. Always returns 204, even when the cookie is missing or unknown.

**Roles:** public.

**Roles:** any authenticated user.

post.description:
Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new refresh cookie. Each refresh token works once.

**Roles:** any holder of a valid refresh cookie.

**Reuse detection:** presenting an already-rotated or revoked token revokes the whole token family and returns 401, so a stolen token cannot be used silently.

The refresh token is set in an `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict` cookie scoped to `/api/v1/auth`; it is never returned in the body. Swagger UI sends it automatically when served from the same origin as the API.

401.description: Refresh cookie missing, expired or reused

post.description:
Creates a user, a new organization, and an admin membership, then signs the user in.

**Roles:** public.

The refresh token is set in an `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict` cookie scoped to `/api/v1/auth`; it is never returned in the body. Swagger UI sends it automatically when served from the same origin as the API.

**Audit:** `org.created` and `auth.login` entries arrive with the audit log (Phase 5).
post.summary: Sign up and create an organization

post.description:
Issues a new access token (and a new refresh cookie) scoped to another organization the caller belongs to. The previous session's refresh token family is revoked.

**Roles:** any member of the target organization.

Returns 404 both when the organization does not exist and when the caller is not a member, so existence is not revealed.

The refresh token is set in an `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict` cookie scoped to `/api/v1/auth`; it is never returned in the body. Swagger UI sends it automatically when served from the same origin as the API.
